summary: Round-2 re-review of Task 10 (subscribers list + profile pages). All four round-1 fixes are correctly applied and verified, with no regressions. The full Vitest suite passes (34 files / 290 tests) and the locale parity gate exits 0; locale files were not touched. No new blocking issues found.

suggestions.suggestion: toast.warning(resp.message) renders a server-provided string directly into the toast. This is an accepted deviation (no seeded i18n key for blocked/deleted; the message is server-controlled, not user input). Noting only for the eventual Task-2 i18n follow-up so these strings become localizable.
suggestions.benefit: Full i18n coverage once the Task-2 key gap is closed.

suggestions.suggestion: load() is invoked fire-and-forget under `if (import.meta.client) load()`; load() itself catches 404 (redirect) and logs other errors via console.warn, so there is no unhandled rejection. Consistent with the index page pattern. No change required.
suggestions.benefit: n/a — informational confirmation that error handling is complete.
